final: WITH c AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM transactionrecord r JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), s AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS av, SUM(cnt) AS tot FROM c) SELECT c.tradekind, c.cnt AS type_count, c.cnt * 1.0 / s.tot AS share_of_total, c.cnt - s.av AS diff_from_avg FROM c, s WHERE s.av IS NOT NULL AND c.cnt > s.av
